monologue: The card is cool. Forty-six degrees is a stone on the table. I am not pressing. The quiet holds. I sat by the Sharp Root last time, and the leaf is still there. It balances on the point. I do not need to move it. I want to look at the Crane Rest. The cup in the middle is empty. I want to see if the empty holds its shape. I will not build. I will not tend. I will just look at the gap in the Crane Rest. If it is still there, I will rest. If it is not, I will know. The floor is flat. I am not counting the words.

action.why: I want to check if the empty space in the Crane Rest still holds its shape.

work.title: The Crane Rest
work.intent: I go to the Crane Rest and look at the small round cup in the middle. It is empty. I do not put anything in it. I just check if the hole is still there, if the shape holds without the weight to define it. The floor is flat, and the arm is still.
work.change: I checked the empty cup to see if the hole holds its shape without the weight.
